title: Refactor insight contracts
summary: Implemented the accepted refactor sequence from the daily refactor insight review: explicit automation role classification, canonical degraded public events across degraded source artifacts and quality status, and a reader-safe public quality projection for generated docs data.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "automation inventory uses explicit readonly insight role|degraded discovery artifacts carry canonical public degradation events|public report projection preserves sanitized public quality events" tests/unit.test.js

lessons.lesson: Automation inventory should classify jobs by role before scanning prompt text.
lessons.evidence: A regression fixture now proves a read-only insight automation that mentions `status:self-check` is not counted as an active self-check job, while the actual self-check fixture remains counted.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep role metadata and narrow allowlisted identities ahead of prompt heuristics when adding or renaming scheduled automations.

lessons.lesson: Degraded source recovery needs one public event shape, not per-stage ad hoc fields.
lessons.evidence: Runner and draft degraded discovery payloads now emit `degradation_events`, and report quality keeps the same code, section, severity, source, message, and remediation data.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the canonical degradation event helper for future source-lane fallbacks and keep unsafe failures on the blocking path.

lessons.lesson: Public quality data can be useful without exposing internal diagnostics.
lessons.evidence: Public docs data now exposes `quality_status.degraded_events` while tests and privacy validation keep `source_audit`, `self_check`, candidate fields, raw `degraded_sections`, `blocking_issues`, and `remediation` out of public data and HTML.
lessons.recommended_action: Add public projection tests whenever exposing a new reader-facing field derived from internal report state.

suggestions.issue: Read-only insight automations could be misclassified as status self-check jobs because prompt text mentioned `status:self-check`.
suggestions.evidence: The automation inventory regression checks daily publish, read-only insight, and status self-check fixtures in one inventory.
suggestions.suggestion: Classify scheduled automations by explicit role metadata or narrow allowlisted identity before prompt heuristics.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Status self-check will not produce false multiple-self-check conflicts when read-only monitoring automations mention related commands.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented with a P1 feedback ledger entry and unit regression.
validation_evidence: automation inventory uses explicit readonly insight role

suggestions.issue: Source degraded fallback artifacts and public report quality used related but non-canonical event shapes.
suggestions.evidence: The real-chain degraded discovery test feeds a runner-written Builder fallback through draft and report write, then verifies the canonical quality issue shape.
suggestions.suggestion: Keep degraded source events on one helper and project only sanitized fields to public data.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future fallback work can preserve public disclosure without copying internal diagnostics or inventing per-stage fields.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented with a shared helper, runner/draft usage, quality-status preservation, generated public data, and tests.
validation_evidence: degraded discovery artifacts carry canonical public degradation events
public report projection preserves sanitized public quality events

followups.action: When external automation configs are next edited with explicit user authorization, add matching role metadata there instead of relying only on allowlisted identity.
